✅Heat Protection: Two silicone handles for hanging on Teapots, Mugs, Cups to make tea for you. In addition, the silicone part can protect your hands from getting scalded. It also can be removed from the infuser.

✅Extra Fine Mesh: The holes of this tea steeper are so small that you will never have any tea dregs coming out of the holes. This would be a great tea ball for those who like loose tea. Let’s enjoy a perfect cup of tea without any tea debris.

✅Easy to Use & Clean: Just put the tea filter into the cup, then pour hot water, after few minutes remove the tea strainer, you could enjoy a wonderful tea. Additionally, Cleaning is pretty easy. Just rinse it with tap water or put it in your dishwasher. No tea stain will leave on the surface.

✅Large Capacity: Large space for loose leaf tea. You are able to make as strong tea as you wish. Share it with your friends and family members. Besides, it’s also good for making loose leaf tea, black tea, oolong, herbs, fruit tea even coffee.
